verdict.rationale: Snowflake ships an official CLI for managing apps/workloads and REST APIs (SQL API and Resource Management API) explicitly designed for programmatic, non-interactive integration and automation, which are the standard mechanisms for running Snowflake operations headlessly in CI pipelines. missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline examples (e.g., GitHub Actions integration) and documentation of non-interactive auth flows (key-pair/OAuth) tailored for headless automation.
